findings: A real full Startseite render calculated several state helpers for the render signature and then recalculated the same values while building the HTML.
Dungeon position was queried twice inside the signature and pet-unseen state was queried twice inside the quickbar markup.
changes: One canonical homeViewSnapshot is now created per v085InstallWorld call.
The same snapshot is reused for the signature and, when a full repaint is needed, for worldHtml.
Dungeon position, Growroom snapshot, achievements, events, checklist, pet count, combat power and worldboss-active state are no longer recomputed during the same full render.
Avatar lookup is reduced to one call inside worldHtml instead of two markup calls.
Rendered content and game rules are unchanged.
